acquisition method: Eluting peptides were analyzed in DDA mode
alkylation reagent: Fifteen micrograms of resolubilized pellet were alkylated with 2-iodoacetamide (30 mM)
alkylation concentration: Fifteen micrograms of resolubilized pellet were alkylated with 2-iodoacetamide (30 mM)
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set to 28
enrichment method: Samp3ylated proteins were purified by α-Flag chromatography
fractionation method: fractionated into 14 fractions by strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX)
instrument: a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) coupled to an RSLC system
labeling: quantified with MaxQuant (version 1.5.3.17) using the LFQ algorithm
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced by addition of β-mercaptoethanol (2% (v/v) final concentration)
reduction concentration: Proteins were reduced by addition of β-mercaptoethanol (2% (v/v) final concentration)
